notes.subject: 2026 redirect to Pow Wow committee
notes.body: LeAnn Shearer replied July 23, 2026 confirming the Kaibab Paiute Tribe's Aug. 15-16 Sounds of Thunder Mountain Pow Wow and directed Adventure Zone to committee chair Tara Spute-Dick and vendor representative Angelita Bulletts, copying them on the email. This was not a decline. Current event listings confirm the 2026 pow wow occurred Aug. 15-16. Before any future outreach, verify whether Tara/Angelita remain the correct committee contacts and continue from this referral.
